id: title:fasyy612:scale player with zoom to avoid crash

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the rendering behavior of the session recording player, specifically the replay iframe scaling strategy, to address iOS crashes and Chrome GPU compositing bugs.
review.reason: The hunk P1.F1.H1 replaces the CSS property used for scaling the replay iframe and removes a scale cap, switching from a GPU compositing layer (transform) to a layout-based scaling (zoom). This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement for the session recording feature, addressing specific compatibility and stability issues.
review.uncertainty: The complete implementation and the specific iOS/Chrome bug contexts are not fully supplied, though the code change itself is clear. No unverified outcomes or adoption metrics are inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only one hunk. No other hunks are supplied, so no relationship between this hunk and other potential changes can be established. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaces the CSS property used for scaling the replay iframe and removes the 0.999 scale cap.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the rendering behavior of the session recording player. The comment suggests this avoids a specific iOS crash and a Chrome GPU compositing bug, and switches the scaling strategy from a GPU compositing layer (transform) to a layout-based scaling (zoom).
